name: Ponytail
author: DietrichGebert
description: Lazy senior-dev mode for AI agents. Stops at the first rung that holds: existing? reuse. Stdlib? use it. Native? use it. Dependency? use it. One line? one line. The best code is the code you never wrote. ~54% less code, ~22% fewer tokens, ~20% cheaper.

view.label: Ponytail
view.description: Lazy senior-dev mode. Sets the active level.

mode.description: Ponytail intensity. lite = small change, full = feature, ultra = refactor/audit, off = bypass.

external.description: Ponytail is a published npm skill. This mod records the level and provides a dashboard toggle; install the npm package separately to load the SKILL.md.
